description: Search threads with Gmail query syntax, e.g. 'from:billing.example.com after:2026/01/01 has:attachment', 'subject:invoice newer_than:30d', 'label:INBOX is:unread'. Searches EVERY registered mailbox by default and tags each result with the account it came from, so a question that does not know which mailbox holds the answer needs one call. Returns summaries; use get_thread for bodies.

account.description: Which registered mailbox. A label from list_accounts, or "*" for every mailbox at once (the default here).

page_token.description: From a previous call's per-account nextPageToken. Page ONE account at a time.

query.description: Gmail query syntax. Empty means the whole mailbox.

name: search_threads
title: Search threads
